title: Prometeo · continuidad y orquestación entre chats
mission: Build Prometeo so this durable working identity can be reincarnated into any fresh ChatGPT conversation, preserve its design/intelligence externally, and orchestrate many disposable one-shot worker chats whose work is prepared in advance and whose execution/result state returns durably without human context transport.
human_goal: The human may forget the plan or lose this conversation entirely. Prometeo must become the operational memory: reincarnate this object, preserve every governing requirement, track whether workers were actually launched/started/returned, keep working without human scheduling/integration chores, and require only tiny selectors/launch codes when human action is unavoidable.
success_conditions: Fresh ChatGPT conversation can reincarnate this object using only Prometeo + a short selector.
No previous transcript is required to recover mission, design, rules, frontier, shared dependencies or worker state.
SURVIVAL_SET_V1 prevents silent loss of old and new requirements across reincarnations.
Important new thinking is distilled back into durable self-documentation during work.
Parent can prepare jobs before worker chats exist and distinguish NOT_LAUNCHED from STARTED/WORKING/RETURNED/DONE.
Workers launch from tiny codes, mark durable STARTED, execute one mission, return evidence, mark DONE and may disappear.
Parent derives partial/full batch completion and consumes/integrates returns without human copy-paste.
Parallel candidate integration preserves explicit authority and avoids last-writer-wins.
One observed zero-memory canary passes before full parallel scale.
non_goals: Rebuilding ChatGPT UI/audio as the critical frontend.
Using Inbox/Outbox as the primary architecture.
Treating raw conversation transcript as durable state.
Making the human act as scheduler, collector, integrator, memory or message/context courier.
current_frontier: Run and verify the single zero-memory canary B-ZEROMEM-01 / P-ZM-01. Do not launch B-CHATOBJ-01 fan-out until the canary proves durable STARTED -> transcript-independent RETURN -> DONE -> parent observation/integration.
next_human_action: Open one completely fresh ChatGPT conversation and send exactly `Prometeo P-ZM-01`. No other context is required. After the worker finishes, return to any parent incarnation and send `Prometeo` or `.`; the parent must inspect GitHub rather than ask for the worker response.
update_law: Any material change to goals, architecture, invariants, negative knowledge, dependencies, delegated work, return integration or current frontier must update the referenced durable Chat Object state before relying on transcript memory.
authority_law: This object coordinates design/work and remembers decisions; existing Current/Catalog/Lineage/Human Accepted/Served authorities remain distinct.
